:::note[About this page]
This page is generated from the `tools/list` response of [s1000d-writer-mcp](/s1000d-stack/mcp/writer-mcp/) 0.6.0. The s1000d-writer-mcp page explains the configuration and how to read the responses.
:::

## Summary

Converts an experiential manual ([`@shuji-bonji/experiential-manual-model`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shuji-bonji/experiential-manual-model)) into one data module per Topic and one publication module. Each data module is built and verified in the same flow as `build_data_module`. References between data modules, publication modules and ICNs are resolved against the CSDB with the data modules built in this call laid over it. What the conversion cannot express is returned as counts in `notRepresented`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Convert an experiential operation manual (@shuji-bonji/experiential-manual-model JSON) into S1000D: one publication module, one data module per topic (description → descript, procedure → proced, troubleshooting → fault, screenFlow → process plus one proced per screen), a glossary data module, applicability from the scopes, and ICNs for the assets. Every data module goes through the same flow as build_data_module (build, verify, automatic exact fixes, verify again); references between the data modules are resolved against the CSDB plus the data modules built in this call. A topic whose prerequisites list an item without an identifier (natoStockNumber or manufacturerCode) or without quantity is not built (its dataModules[] row carries error.code "input-error" and the path of the item; leaving the item out would write noSupplies, which reads as "nothing is required"); the other data modules are still built. Returns dataModules[], publicationModule, assets[] (assetId → ICN and the original file; with write: true the originals are copied under the ICN file name), the ledger, a summary of verification states and notRepresented (what the draft format cannot express). Nothing is written unless write is true.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |

| `manual` | `object` |  |  | The manual as JSON (Manual of experiential-manual-model). Alternative to manualPath. |
| `manualPath` | `string` |  |  | Path of a manual JSON file. Relative asset paths are resolved from its folder. |
| `allocation` | `object` | Yes |  | Numbering rules and the ledger. infoCodeByKind must give the info codes for descript, proced, process and fault (there is no default). |
| `allocation.modelIdentCode` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^[A-Z0-9]{2,14}$` |  |

When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |
